Perplexity for a source-checking trial

Start here if you want to inspect a linked source next to an answer. In our November 25 exercise, signed-in Perplexity Search and ChatGPT both answered three questions covering seven required facts with supporting primary links. This small exercise did not separate them on overall accuracy.

The anonymous Perplexity attempt did not return a research answer in that session; the signed-in run did. One extra date qualifier in a ChatGPT answer needed a clearer source or time-zone scope. A source count alone did not prove every claim.

Open replies and the source-audit worksheetDownload the shared research promptOpen Perplexity

Repeat with a low-risk question from your work. Open each linked primary source and record whether it supports the particular claim. Keep unanswered questions and unsupported extras in the comparison.

Claude for a document and table trial

Use a small supplied document rather than judging an assistant by a polished greeting. Our three-part prompt combined paid-order arithmetic, evidence from a fictional policy and a short notice with explicit constraints.

Both first answers identified five paid orders, a net total of 138 USD and order A104 as the highest net order. Claude’s first copied answer included prose around the requested JSON; one explicit correction produced valid JSON. ChatGPT’s retained visible text parsed as JSON. Capture methods differed and the models and plans were not matched, so this is a reproducible task example rather than a product ranking.

Inspect original replies and run the checkerDownload the shared document and table taskOpen Claude

If a workflow needs machine-readable output, test the exact copied response in your parser. Keep the first attempt and count corrections instead of silently cleaning the response.

Gemini for an image-creation trial

Gemini is another place to try a visual brief if its image tool is available on your account. In our two November 25 creation briefs, both Gemini and ChatGPT returned the requested three mugs and exact four-line poster wording in the first retained samples. There was no measured overall quality winner.

See the four original images and account observations, or use the AI image generator selector and brief builder to make a trial for your own task. The image tool’s current availability and quotas must be checked on your account.

Try one task before moving your workflow

  1. Write down the reason for switching: unavailable feature, answer quality, source checking, repository access or local execution.
  2. Choose one task with a result you can independently check. Use a fictional or permitted sample before uploading working material.
  3. Keep the first output, the corrections and your final result. Check account access and limits before relying on the workflow.
  4. Compare effort and usable results across several tasks. Choose a plan only after checking its current terms, allowances and the features you actually need.

None of these services is established here as an unlimited free replacement. Our trials do not cover large-file limits, API pricing, confidential-data suitability or all paid tiers. Coding agents and local models need separate setup and permission checks; they do not automatically reproduce ChatGPT’s web tools.

For a single head-to-head question, the linked comparison pages retain the details. This page helps you choose which task trial to run first.

What was tested and when

The three assistant comparisons were executed November 25, 2026, using English prompts in web apps with Chinese UI controls. Account settings, model access and timing were not controlled uniformly. The source and text exercises are small synthetic tasks; the image exercise has two briefs per app. They establish the stated observations, not a general reliability rate.

Read the document-task reference, research reference and image observations. The full comparison pages link the unchanged first responses and original captures.

Official image instructions checked November 27: Gemini image creation and editing and ChatGPT Images. Access observed on November 25 is a dated session result, not a promise about today’s quota. No provider paid for placement.
